# Stub Model

A stub card whose limitations section is a bullet list, the shape the harvester
has to read instead of cutting a fragment out of the heading.

## Evaluation

Scores are reported on the usual suites.

## Limitations and Biases

- **Factual reliability.** The model may generate incorrect information; verify
  outputs before relying on them.
- **Modality.** Text-only; no native multimodal understanding.
- **Bias.** The model can reproduce social biases present in its training data.
